sensors_exact_units.scope: Shared existing I2C1 GPIO31/32 only: INA226 config/read at 0x41, BMI270 identity/config/read at 0x68, RX8130CE read and fitted backup-supply enable at 0x32. No charger, rail, camera, USB host, radio or other GPIO authorization. Exact-unit firmware installation requires a separate artifact authorization. Explicit UTC sync adds RX8130CE calendar 0x10..0x16 writes, VLF-only W0C at 0x1D and clearing pre-existing STOP at 0x1E after readback, per pinned Epson application manual. No alarm, timer, clock-output or digital-offset configuration changes.
